title: The Fighting Cricket
synopsis: A tale of the hardships facing a man trying to find a fierce cricket for the emperor!

fullText.simplified:
到了小山，成名真的找到了有很多大石头的地方。但是他左看看右看看，没有看到梦中的大石头和三条腿的黑狗。他又往前走了一会儿，突然听到一声狗叫，回头一看，是只三条腿的黑狗，站在一块大石头旁边。真的和梦里的一样！成名二话不说，跟着狗，走进了草地。走了很久很久，他看到了一块红色的石头。走近一看，石头上面真的有一只头是绿色的蛐蛐。
    成名高兴得说不出话来。他赶紧去捉蛐蛐。只见蛐蛐跳进了草地，成名赶紧去追！终于，他把蛐蛐捉进了笼子里。把笼子拿近一看，这蛐蛐两条腿很大，一看就是一只厉害的蛐蛐！成名高兴地大叫了一声：“太好了！”，好像他那两条腿也好多了。他带着蛐蛐，唱着歌儿回家了。
    回到家中，成名的妻子看到蛐蛐，也很高兴：“这下好了！真的太好了！你快把蛐蛐拿去给市长吧！”
    “今天太晚了，市长已经下班了。我明天一大早就拿去。”
    “也对。那我去买点好菜，我们好多天没有好好吃饭了，今晚可以好好吃饭了。”说完，妻子高高兴兴地出门买菜了。她买了很多菜，准备晚上做好菜吃。她还买了一个新笼子，小心地把绿头蛐蛐放在里面。成名去买了很多蛐蛐爱吃的东西，什么贵就买什么！成名和妻子看着新笼子里的蛐蛐：这下好了！蛐蛐找到了！房子不用卖了！成名也不用再被打了！蛐蛐在笼子里叫着，两人在心里唱着歌：就等着明天把蛐蛐送去给市长了！
fullText.traditional:
到了小山，成名真的找到了有很多大石頭的地方。但是他左看看右看看，沒有看到夢中的大石頭和三條腿的黑狗。他又往前走了一會兒，突然聽到一聲狗叫，回頭一看，是隻三條腿的黑狗，站在一塊大石頭旁邊。真的和夢裡的一樣！成名二話不說，跟著狗，走進了草地。走了很久很久，他看到了一塊紅色的石頭。走近一看，石頭上面真的有一隻頭是綠色的蛐蛐。
    成名高興得說不出話來。他趕緊去捉蛐蛐。只見蛐蛐跳進了草地，成名趕緊去追！終於，他把蛐蛐捉進了籠子裡。把籠子拿近一看，這蛐蛐兩條腿很大，一看就是一隻厲害的蛐蛐！成名高興地大叫了一聲：“太好了！”，好像他那兩條腿也好多了。他帶著蛐蛐，唱著歌兒回家了。
    回到家中，成名的妻子看到蛐蛐，也很高興：“這下好了！真的太好了！你快把蛐蛐拿去給市長吧！”
    “今天太晚了，市長已經下班了。我明天一大早就拿去。”
    “也對。那我去買點好菜，我們好多天沒有好好吃飯了，今晚可以好好吃飯了。”說完，妻子高高興興地出門買菜了。她買了很多菜，準備晚上做好菜吃。她還買了一個新籠子，小心地把綠頭蛐蛐放在裡面。成名去買了很多蛐蛐愛吃的東西，什麼貴就買什麼！成名和妻子看著新籠子裡的蛐蛐：這下好了！蛐蛐找到了！房子不用賣了！成名也不用再被打了！蛐蛐在籠子裡叫著，兩人在心裡唱著歌：就等著明天把蛐蛐送去給市長了！

sentences.traditional: 到了小山，成名真的找到了有很多大石頭的地方。

sentences.english: Arriving at the small hill, Cheng Ming really did find a place with many large rocks.

sentences.traditional: 但是他左看看右看看，

sentences.english: But he looked to the left and to the right, ..

sentences.simplified: 没有看到梦中的大石头和三条腿的黑狗。
sentences.traditional: 沒有看到夢中的大石頭和三條腿的黑狗。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu kàn dào mèng zhōng de dà shí tou hé sān tiáo tuǐ de hēi gǒu
sentences.english: .. and didn’t see the large rock with a three-legged black dog from his dream.

sentences.simplified: 他又往前走了一会儿，突然听到一声狗叫，

sentences.english: He walked a bit closer, and suddenly heard a dog barking.

sentences.simplified: 回头一看，是只三条腿的黑狗，站在一块大石头旁边。
sentences.traditional: 回頭一看，是隻三條腿的黑狗，站在一塊大石頭旁邊。

sentences.english: He turned around to look, and there was the three-legged black dog standing next to a large rock.

sentences.simplified: 真的和梦里的一样！成名二话不说，跟着狗，
sentences.traditional: 真的和夢裡的一樣！成名二話不說，跟著狗，
sentences.pinyin: zhēn de hé mèng lǐ de yí yàng chéng míng èr huà bù shuō gēn zhe gǒu
sentences.english: It really was just like in his dream! Cheng Ming followed the dog without hesitation.

sentences.simplified: 走进了草地。走了很久很久，他看到了一块红色的石头。
sentences.traditional: 走進了草地。走了很久很久，他看到了一塊紅色的石頭。
sentences.pinyin: zǒu jìn le cǎo dì zǒu le hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ tā kàn dào le yí kuài hóng sè de shí tou
sentences.english: They walked into a meadow. After walking for a long time, he saw a red rock.

sentences.simplified: 走近一看，石头上面真的有一只头是绿色的蛐蛐。
sentences.traditional: 走近一看，石頭上面真的有一隻頭是綠色的蛐蛐。
sentences.pinyin: zǒu jìn yí kàn shí tou shàng miàn zhēn de yǒu yì zhī tóu shì lǜ sè de qū qū
sentences.english: He approached it and immediately saw that there really was a green-headed cricket on the rock.

sentences.simplified: 成名高兴得说不出话来。他赶紧去捉蛐蛐。
sentences.traditional: 成名高興得說不出話來。他趕緊去捉蛐蛐。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng gāo xìng de shuō bu chū huà lái tā gǎn jǐn qù zhuō qū qū
sentences.english: Cheng Ming was speechless with joy. He hurried to catch the cricket.

sentences.simplified: 只见蛐蛐跳进了草地，成名赶紧去追！
sentences.traditional: 只見蛐蛐跳進了草地，成名趕緊去追！
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ jiàn qū qū tiào jìn le cǎo dì chéng míng gǎn jǐn qù zhuī
sentences.english: Seeing the cricket hop into the meadow, Cheng Ming hurriedly chased after it!

sentences.simplified: 终于，他把蛐蛐捉进了笼子里。
sentences.traditional: 終於，他把蛐蛐捉進了籠子裡。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú tā bǎ qū qū zhuō jìn le lóng zi lǐ
sentences.english: Finally, he captured the cricket in a cage.

sentences.simplified: 把笼子拿近一看，这蛐蛐两条腿很大，一看就是一只厉害的蛐蛐！
sentences.traditional: 把籠子拿近一看，這蛐蛐兩條腿很大，一看就是一隻厲害的蛐蛐！
sentences.pinyin: bǎ lóng zi ná jìn yí kàn zhè qū qū liǎng tiáo tuǐ hěn dà yí kàn jiù shì yì zhī lì hai de qū qū
sentences.english: He held the cage closer, and immediately saw that the cricket had two big legs and was a very fierce cricket!

sentences.simplified: 成名高兴地大叫了一声：“太好了！”，好像他那两条腿也好多了。他带着蛐蛐，唱着歌儿回家了。
sentences.traditional: 成名高興地大叫了一聲：“太好了！”，好像他那兩條腿也好多了。他帶著蛐蛐，唱著歌兒回家了。
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng gāo xìng de dà jiào le yì shēng tài hǎo le hǎo xiàng tā nà liǎng tiáo tuǐ yě hǎo duō le tā dài zhe qū qū chàng zhe gē'r huí jiā le
sentences.english: Cheng Ming happily shouted, ”Great!” These two legs look much better. He sang as he brought the cricket home.

sentences.simplified: 回到家中，成名的妻子看到蛐蛐，也很高兴：
sentences.traditional: 回到家中，成名的妻子看到蛐蛐，也很高興：
sentences.pinyin: huí dào jiā zhōng chéng míng de qī zi kàn dào qū qū yě hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: After he got back home, Cheng Ming’s wife was also happy when she saw the cricket, ..

sentences.simplified: “这下好了！真的太好了！你快把蛐蛐拿去给市长吧！”
sentences.traditional: “這下好了！真的太好了！你快把蛐蛐拿去給市長吧！”
sentences.pinyin: zhè xià hǎo le zhēn de tài hǎo le nǐ kuài bǎ qū qū ná qù gěi shì zhǎng ba
sentences.english: .. “This time it’s a good one! It’s really great! Make haste and give the cricket to the mayor!”

sentences.simplified: “今天太晚了，市长已经下班了。我明天一大早就拿去。”
sentences.traditional: “今天太晚了，市長已經下班了。我明天一大早就拿去。”
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān tài wǎn le shì zhǎng yǐ jīng xià bān le wǒ míng tiān yí dà zǎo jiù ná qù
sentences.english: “It’s too late today, the mayor has already left work. I’ll go first thing tomorrow morning.”

sentences.simplified: “也对。那我去买点好菜，我们好多天没有好好吃饭了，
sentences.traditional: “也對。那我去買點好菜，我們好多天沒有好好吃飯了，
sentences.pinyin: yě duì nà wǒ qù mǎi diǎn hǎo cài wǒ men hǎo duō tiān méi yǒu hǎo hǎo chī fàn le
sentences.english: “That’s right. Then I’ll go buy some good food. We haven’t eaten properly for several days.

sentences.simplified: 今晚可以好好吃饭了。”说完，妻子高高兴兴地出门买菜了。
sentences.traditional: 今晚可以好好吃飯了。”說完，妻子高高興興地出門買菜了。
sentences.pinyin: jīn wǎn kě yǐ hǎo hǎo chī fàn le shuō wán qī zi gāo gāo xìng xìng de chū mén mǎi cài le
sentences.english: Tonight we can have a proper meal.” After she finished speaking, the wife happily went out to buy food.

sentences.simplified: 她买了很多菜，准备晚上做好菜吃。
sentences.traditional: 她買了很多菜，準備晚上做好菜吃。
sentences.pinyin: tā mǎi le hěn duō cài zhǔn bèi wǎn shang zuò hǎo cài chī
sentences.english: She bought a lot of food, preparing to cook a meal in the evening.

sentences.simplified: 她还买了一个新笼子，小心地把绿头蛐蛐放在里面。
sentences.traditional: 她還買了一個新籠子，小心地把綠頭蛐蛐放在裡面。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái mǎi le yí ge xīn lóng zi xiǎo xīn de bǎ lǜ tóu qū qū fàng zài lǐ miàn
sentences.english: She also bought a new cage, and carefully put the green-headed cricket inside it.

sentences.simplified: 成名去买了很多蛐蛐爱吃的东西，什么贵就买什么！
sentences.traditional: 成名去買了很多蛐蛐愛吃的東西，什麼貴就買什麼！
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng qù mǎi le hěn duō qū qū ài chī de dōng xi shén me guì jiù mǎi shén me
sentences.english: Cheng Ming bought a lot of things that crickets like to eat, no matter how expensive they were!

sentences.simplified: 成名和妻子看着新笼子里的蛐蛐：
sentences.traditional: 成名和妻子看著新籠子裡的蛐蛐：
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng hé qī zi kàn zhe xīn lóng zi lǐ de qū qū
sentences.english: Cheng Ming and his wife looked at the cricket in the new cage.

sentences.simplified: 这下好了！蛐蛐找到了！
sentences.traditional: 這下好了！蛐蛐找到了！
sentences.pinyin: zhè xià hǎo le qū qū zhǎo dào le
sentences.english: It was okay this time! They had found a cricket!

sentences.simplified: 房子不用卖了！成名也不用再被打了！
sentences.traditional: 房子不用賣了！成名也不用再被打了！
sentences.pinyin: fáng zi bú yòng mài le chéng míng yě bú yòng zài bèi dǎ le
sentences.english: They didn’t have to sell their house! Cheng Ming also didn’t have to get beaten again!

sentences.simplified: 蛐蛐在笼子里叫着，两人在心里唱着歌：
sentences.traditional: 蛐蛐在籠子裡叫著，兩人在心裡唱著歌：
sentences.pinyin: qū qū zài lóng zi lǐ jiào zhe liǎng rén zài xīn li chàng zhe gē
sentences.english: The cricket chirped in the cage, and the two of them sang to themselves:

sentences.simplified: 就等着明天把蛐蛐送去给市长了！
sentences.traditional: 就等著明天把蛐蛐送去給市長了！
sentences.pinyin: jiù děng zhe míng tiān bǎ qū qū sòng qù gěi shì zhǎng le
sentences.english: Just wait until tomorrow when we give the cricket to the mayor!

raw.synopsis: A tale of the hardships facing a man trying to find a fierce cricket for the emperor!
sentence_translations: Arriving at the small hill, Cheng Ming really did find a place with many large rocks.
But he looked to the left and to the right, ..
.. and didn’t see the large rock with a three-legged black dog from his dream.
He walked a bit closer, and suddenly heard a dog barking.
He turned around to look, and there was the three-legged black dog standing next to a large rock.
It really was just like in his dream! Cheng Ming followed the dog without hesitation.
They walked into a meadow. After walking for a long time, he saw a red rock.
He approached it and immediately saw that there really was a green-headed cricket on the rock.
Cheng Ming was speechless with joy. He hurried to catch the cricket.
Seeing the cricket hop into the meadow, Cheng Ming hurriedly chased after it!
Finally, he captured the cricket in a cage.
He held the cage closer, and immediately saw that the cricket had two big legs and was a very fierce cricket!
Cheng Ming happily shouted, ”Great!” These two legs look much better. He sang as he brought the cricket home.
After he got back home, Cheng Ming’s wife was also happy when she saw the cricket, ..
.. “This time it’s a good one! It’s really great! Make haste and give the cricket to the mayor!”
“It’s too late today, the mayor has already left work. I’ll go first thing tomorrow morning.”
“That’s right. Then I’ll go buy some good food. We haven’t eaten properly for several days.
Tonight we can have a proper meal.” After she finished speaking, the wife happily went out to buy food.
She bought a lot of food, preparing to cook a meal in the evening.
She also bought a new cage, and carefully put the green-headed cricket inside it.
Cheng Ming bought a lot of things that crickets like to eat, no matter how expensive they were!
Cheng Ming and his wife looked at the cricket in the new cage.
It was okay this time! They had found a cricket!
They didn’t have to sell their house! Cheng Ming also didn’t have to get beaten again!
The cricket chirped in the cage, and the two of them sang to themselves:
Just wait until tomorrow when we give the cricket to the mayor!
